description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults threatened with a utility shut-off in the past year, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: health-isolation
source: CDC PLACES (local estimates from BRFSS), tract and county
title: Social isolation
description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults who feel socially isolated, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: health-snap
source: CDC PLACES (local estimates from BRFSS), tract and county
title: Received SNAP (food stamps)
description: CDC PLACES model estimate (2025 release): adults who received SNAP in the past year, by census tract (county when zoomed out). Not measured in every state (none for TX, FL, PA and 8 others).

name: broadband-unserved
source: FCC Broadband Data Collection (National Broadband Map), via Esri
title: No high-speed internet available
description: Share of homes and businesses where no provider offers 100/20 Mbps service (FCC 'unserved' plus 'underserved' locations), by block group (tract, county and state when zoomed out). Latest FCC Broadband Data Collection, via Esri.
title_es: Sin internet de alta velocidad disponible

name: food-deserts
source: USDA ERS Food Access Research Atlas (2025)
title: Food deserts (low income, low access)
description: Low-income census tracts where many residents live more than 1 mile (urban) or 10 miles (rural) by road from a SNAP-authorized grocery store. USDA ERS Food Access Research Atlas, 2025 edition.

name: nri-risk
source: FEMA National Risk Index
title: Natural hazard risk (FEMA)
description: FEMA National Risk Index composite risk score (national percentile, 0-100: expected losses from 18 hazards, social vulnerability and resilience), by census tract (county when zoomed out). Dec 2025 release.

name: hud-lihtc
source: HUD Low-Income Housing Tax Credit database
title: Tax-credit affordable housing (LIHTC)
description: Rental properties built or rehabilitated with Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (HUD LIHTC database, updated Dec 2024).

name: hud-public-housing
source: HUD public housing developments
title: Public housing developments
description: Public housing developments run by local housing authorities (HUD).

name: hud-vouchers
source: HUD Housing Choice Vouchers by tract
title: Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8)
description: Housing Choice Vouchers in use as a share of renter-occupied homes, by census tract (HUD). Tracts with too few vouchers to report are blank.

name: hud-fmr
source: HUD Fair Market Rents (latest published)
title: Fair Market Rent (2-bedroom)
description: HUD Fair Market Rent for a 2-bedroom home (rent plus basic utilities), by FMR area (metro area or county). Latest published year in HUD's service (its notes say FY2024 but it was updated Sept 2025).

name: opportunity-zones
source: HUD / U.S. Treasury Opportunity Zones
title: Opportunity Zones
description: Census tracts designated as Qualified Opportunity Zones in 2018 (2010 tracts; HUD / CDFI Fund).

name: opportunity-zones-2
source: HUD Opportunity Zones 2.0 eligible tracts
title: Opportunity Zones 2.0 (eligible)
description: Census tracts eligible to be nominated for the 2027-2036 Opportunity Zones under the 2025 law (HUD, April 2026). Eligible is not designated.

name: cejst-disadvantaged
source: CEQ Climate and Economic Justice Screening Tool v1.0 (archived 2022)
title: Disadvantaged communities (CEJST, archived)
description: Census tracts the former Climate & Economic Justice Screening Tool identified as disadvantaged: archived 2022 v1.0 (2010 tracts), as re-hosted by Esri. The tool itself is no longer online.

name: new-homes-permits
source: U.S. Census Bureau Building Permits Survey via HUD (through 2022)
title: New homes permitted (2022)
description: Housing units authorized by building permits in 2022, by county (Census Building Permits Survey via HUD; this service runs through 2022).

name: wildfire-hazard-potential
source: USDA Forest Service, Wildfire Hazard Potential 2023 (RMRS Fire Modeling Institute)
title: Wildfire hazard potential
description: USDA Forest Service Wildfire Hazard Potential (2023): how hard a wildfire would be to contain, very low to very high, lower 48 states. A modeled index, not a legal zone.
title_es: Potencial de peligro de incendio forestal

name: landslide-susceptibility
source: USGS national landslide susceptibility (Mirus et al.)
title: Landslide susceptibility
description: USGS map of where slopes are prone to landslides, lower 48 states.

name: sea-level-rise
source: NOAA Office for Coastal Management, Sea Level Rise Viewer (3 ft scenario)
title: Sea-level rise: 3 ft
description: NOAA: coastal land that would be under water at high tide with 3 feet of sea-level rise (all US coasts).
title_es: Aumento del nivel del mar: 3 pies (0.9 m)

name: storm-surge
source: NOAA National Hurricane Center, storm surge risk maps (Category 3)
title: Storm surge risk: Category 3
description: NOAA National Hurricane Center: how deep storm-surge flooding could get in a Category 3 hurricane (Atlantic and Gulf coasts, Puerto Rico, Hawaii).

name: environmental-justice
source: CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024
title: Environmental justice index
description: CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024: combined environmental, social and health burden, as a national percentile by census tract (zoom in to see tracts).

name: extreme-heat-days
source: CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024 (extreme heat days)
title: Extreme heat days per year
description: Average days a year above the local 95th-percentile high temperature, by census tract (CDC/ATSDR Environmental Justice Index 2024).
title_es: Días de calor extremo al año

name: social-vulnerability
source: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022
title: Social vulnerability index
description: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index 2022: how hard it may be for a community to prepare for and recover from a disaster, as a national percentile (tracts; counties when zoomed out).

name: radon
source: USGS / EPA Geologic Radon Potential of the United States (2025)
title: Radon potential (1 low - 3 high)
description: USGS/EPA geologic radon potential by geologic province: 3 = high (test your home), 2 = moderate, 1 = low. Any home can have high radon; only a test tells.

name: faults-usa
source: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database
title: Earthquake faults (US)
description: USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold Database: faults active in the last 1.6 million years.

name: landslides

title: Mapped landslides
description: USGS U.S. Landslide Inventory: landslides mapped by federal and state surveys.

title: Hurricane forecast cones
description: Where active tropical storms and hurricanes may track (NHC forecast cones).

title: Disaster recovery centers

title: Drinking water violations

title: Lakes & reservoirs
